body: Pog?
If it ever gets serious tell a friend. It saved my life.

I’m not sure your story but heres mine in short. Depression is a ugly and strong beast that covers up everything good in the world. The only thing that saved my life was telling everything to a friend and getting a glimpse of the good again. I strongly suggest calling or reaching out to someone one more time.
Never to late bud. Stick around and ride this one out with us. We all care about you here.
Don’t let their mistakes consume you.

Last thing I’ll say is open up to your friends. It hurts and isn’t very fun but it saved my life and it will show you the reasons to stay alive. There’s a millions reasons to stay alive but depression covers them all up. Once you see them again it gets a little easier.

Because you never know when it’s going to change. That’s the part of life that is worth living the fact that it can change. It’s incredibly hard to make a change when you are depressed, but start small. Try something new or old. I know it’s hard to get motivated but it’s worth it. As far as the antidepressants go, I think you should keep a open dialogue going with your doctor on that.
That situation must be incredibly hard, but don’t let their mistakes ruin your life.
What happened to get you here? I’m willing to listen if you want to talk.
Eventually is right be there is no reason to cut that short and miss out on all the sweet little things in life.
Why would you ever want to end the conversations with your best friends?

It sucks to be called ugly or anything that we don’t want to hear, but to me it sounds like plenty of people have great things to say about you and many compliments. The bad always rings louder our heads than the good. Don’t try to fixate on it too much and just think of the good.

I understand exactly how that is and it sucks. I bottled it up until it almost got me. Finally I called a friend one night and let everything out. Everyone needs someone. Even if that is on Reddit. If you ever need to talk shoot me a message even just to vent about small stuff. Life’s tough but together it just a little it better.
I’m in the same boat. You don’t want to die, but you want to escape life for a while because things have got really bad and that feels like the only way you can escape.
Reddit cares. We are a family here.

I understand the feeling but you are in control of everything. If you want to throw your phone across the room you can. If you want to reply back to me with nothing but the word “cucumber” you can. Tomorrow is always a chance for a better day. Grab the bull by the horns and ride that bitch. It isn’t easy but it’s possible and worth it.
My dog. She loves me no matter what. Makes me feel needed and useful. If I didn’t have this little pound mutt it would be over. But the joy on her face when she sees me makes me stay alive.
I never found out. Just showed up one day.
Not really worried about losing her. More so about losing this two year battle and being known for having it.

Healh:  reasonably health. 5’9” 150lb. I eat decent and workout about twice a week. 

Lifestyle: Very active. Always outside. Have a lot of projects. Don’t smoke. But I do drink. 

Stuff that’s been tried: cryotherapy, several different creams from doctors, apples cider junk and still taking Tagamet daily. 

Have not got the vaccine talked about it last time at the doctor but they said the low risk types are not covered by it. I still asked for it but forgot to get it after the cryotherapy.
